name: ContentCollab: 5xx share per route above 2% over 5 minutes
message:
More than 2% of the requests to {{route.name}} answered 5xx in the last 5 minutes (now {{value}}, as a fraction of the requests).

Find the failing requests: Logs, search `@http.route:"{{route.name}}" @http.status_code:[500 TO 599]`, then follow one `@http.request_id` through the log. Check `kubectl -n contentcollab get pods` and `kubectl -n contentcollab logs deploy/api`; /health answers 503 when PostgreSQL or Redis is down.

A route with few requests can cross 2% on a single failure: read the request count on the dashboard before acting.
